title: Solid-state batteries: The critical role of mechanics

Thus, the pressure climbs until it is limited by either the critical stress required to ex-nihilo create dislocations, fracture of the SSE, or, as per Barroso-Luque, (82) the stress saturates due to a change in the local potential such that Li+ no longer plates to the defect interface.
